description: MainActivity class for an Android application demonstrating device credential authentication and cryptographic key management using the Android Keystore system. The code handles creation of secure keys that require user authentication, starts authentication prompts, and performs encryption operations contingent on successful authentication.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity handling device credential authentication and cryptographic operations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, checks for secure lock screen, creates cryptographic key, and sets up the purchase button click handler.

methods.name: tryEncrypt
methods.description: Attempts to encrypt data with the stored key, prompting for user authentication if necessary.

methods.name: createKey
methods.description: Generates a symmetric encryption key in Android Keystore requiring user authentication within a specified duration.

methods.name: showAuthenticationScreen
methods.description: Launches an intent to prompt the user for device credentials.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result of the device credential confirmation, proceeding with encryption if successful.

methods.name: showPurchaseConfirmation
methods.description: Displays confirmation UI after successful authentication and encryption.

methods.name: showAlreadyAuthenticated
methods.description: Indicates the user has recently authenticated within the validity window.
